description_expanded: Enjoy the lush and relaxed vibe at this new beachy mid-century modern home in the heart of 30A. Top Reasons to Book this Stunning NatureWalk Home:* 6-Seater Golf Cart Included ($500 refundable deposit is required.)* 6 Bikes Included* 4 Desks throughout home for Remote Workers or Online Classes* 2 Large Private Porches, Outdoor Patio* First Floor King Master Suite and 2nd Floor Master Suite* Pack 'n Play included* Private Enclosed Heated Outdoor Shower* Quiet Neighborhood, surrounded by bike and walking trails and a state park.* Access to "The Gathering Place" with Pools, Hammocks, Grills, hot tub, and Fire Pit* Walking and Biking Distance to Unique Local Shopping and Dining Options* Modern new furniture.* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service Welcome to Casa Pura Vida, a relaxed, modern 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home located in the beautiful NatureWalk community. This spacious home is located across the street from woodlands and a picturesque pond and is surrounded by numerous bike and walking trails. Step through the front door to be greeted by the open living and dining areas as well as a well-appointed spacious kitchen. A king master suite is located on the first floor by the back porch. The remaining bedrooms are located on the second floor and include a Master King bedroom, a California King Bedroom, a bedroom with a Full bed, and an office which includes a queen sleeper sofa and a large desk. This home sleeps 10 comfortably. There is also a brand new pack n' play available and 4 desks for remote learners or workers. Parking is available for 3 cars, and there are additional parking spots on the street nearby.To see if your pet qualifies for this home, please contact us with the following info: Breed, age, and weight of your dog. No other pets besides dogs are allowed. Please note there is a pet fee of $725 per reservation.Message for Monthly Winter Rates - Snowbird Season runs January through February. Not Available to Guests under age 25.Emerald Coast Beach Service offers NatureWalk guests 10% off for beach chairs and umbrella set up on beach - upon booking reach out for PROMO code!The Bed Setup:1st Floor:Master Suite: King Bed2nd Floor:Master Suite: King BedGuest Bedroom: California King BedGuest Bedroom: Full BedOffice Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa NatureWalk 30A is in a prime location on Hwy 395 off of 30A, next to Watercolor and Seaside and surrounded by Point Washington State Forest. Explore the endless trails by bike or on foot. NatureWalk 30A has a private path “Lilly Lane Beach Trail” to San Juan Avenue which has beach access. This path goes through the beautiful state forest which also surrounds NatureWalk 30A. Several additional beach accesses are also located along 30A within a mile. The beaches at Seaside or Watercolor, as well as Grayton Beach State Park are a short walk, bike ride or golf cart ride away. NatureWalk’s “Gathering Place” boasts a large zero-entry pool, a heated lap pool, hot tub, lounge chairs, tables and chairs, a shaded kiddie pool, hammocks, playground, outdoor kitchen with gas grills, and gas fire pit for family enjoyment. You will also find volleyball courts, pickleball courts, basketball, and another playground nearby. Area Attractions:According to Travel and Leisure, 30A’s 26 miles of idyllic coastline make it the #1 US summer hot spot on Airbnb. The beaches of South Walton County are some of the world’s best, with sugar white sand and clear emerald green waters. South Walton County boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone: paddleboard rentals, kayak rentals, biking, paragliding, fishing, golfing, summer beginner surfing, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here on 30A. The town of Seaside is one of the original communities along 30A. Being in a home next to Seaside is important as the town caters to people walking, biking or in a LSV. The town infuses old Florida charm into its first new Urbanist community. Seaside was named the “Best Beach on Earth” for families by Travel + Leisure magazine and is included in USA Today’s “Top 10 Best Beach Towns in Florida.” The town is forever known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, Repertory Theater, spa, shops, restaurants and Seaside’s iconic tiny post office is one of the most photographed post offices in the world. Seaside offers yoga, movie nights and family friendly events throughout the year. The WaterColor, Florida community begins across the street from the Naturewalk entrance on 395. It starts at the the Gulf of Mexico and wraps around Seaside to Naturewalk. Watercolor is a beach town with rich landscaping and incredible parks that blend perfectly into Northwest Florida’s natural scrub oak and palmetto. It is home to picturesque Western Lake, South Walton’s largest coastal dune lake. Both gravel and paved paths and bridges are throughout Watercolor, great for biking or walking. At Watercolor’s boathouse you can do stand up paddle-boarding, kayaking, or canoeing. Watercolor is also home to the James Beard award-winning restaurant, Fish Out of Water, that has great food and amazing ocean views.PLEASE NOTE:*Due to an HOA restriction, boats, RVs, and trailers are not allowed in this neighborhood *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25.*Do not ride bikes at night without a light on the front and back.*This property is strictly non-smoking, and no smoking is allowed inside the home or anywhere on the property.*Guests will be charged $150 for a lost or missing amenity pass and $150 for a lost golf cart key. Please leave the amenity pass and the key in the home upon departure.*PET FRIENDLY WITH STIPULATIONS: Guests who want to bring pets are required to send a picture of the pet with breed and weight, and age prior to booking for approval. We require that your pet (dogs only) be completely potty trained. We prefer dogs older than 2 years old and under 35 lbs. Please do not leave pets unattended in the home, and keep pets off the sofas. There is a one-time non-refundable pet fee of $475 per pet as well as an additional $250 cleaning fee. While we do allow dogs with the mentioned stipulations, any damages that occur during your stay or if an additional cleaning is required, this will be charged to the credit card on file, with the minimum fee being $250.00. If you bring a pet without prior approval, there will be a $700 charge to card on file, in addition to any damages. Read less
